name: Hawaiian Telcom
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public hawaiiantel.com help center pages only (no sign-in). Hawaiian Telcom is the incumbent landline carrier for Hawaii (owned by altafiber, but billed separately through its own My Account at hawaiiantel.com). My Account registration needs the 15-digit account number, name, email, ZIP code and a password, with an email code (plus an automated call code for phone customers); sign-in is by email and password. Fees: online one-time payment $1.95, phone payment $1.95, First Hawaiian Bank branch $2.50; mail and AutoPay free; AutoPay by credit card adds 2.5% of the bill each month (engine applies autopayCardPercent to any card AutoPay, debit included). Late fee: greater of 1.5% of the past-due balance or $15.95 when more than $10.00 is unpaid 30 days after the due date (the engine cannot express the $10 threshold or the 30-day delay). AutoPay collects 10 calendar days before the due date (leadDays 10); it can be capped at a maximum amount (not expressible); stop it in My Account by 9:00 PM HST the night before collection (Billing > AutoPay tab > Edit > do not want AutoPay > Save). eBill is free; turn it on with Get eBill on the Overview page; new-customer promos lose the eBill discount if eBill is not activated within 30 days. A pay-without-signing-in page is not described on the help pages (the footer Pay My Bill link opens My Account), so guest_pay is offline. Cancelling and service changes are by phone, chat or a retail store; billing is prorated to the disconnection date. Payment arrangements by calling 808-643-2356; disconnection no sooner than 14 days after the due date with a 7-day written notice. Payment History shows 24 months; Billing History shows 18 months of bills. Vacation Service (phone only) is 50% off line charges for a one-time $14.00 fee.

sources.title: Account & Billing - Hawaiian Telcom Help Center

guest_pay.note: Online payments are made in My Account. Without logging in you can pay by phone at 808-643-3456 ($1.95 fee), by mail with the remit slip, at a retail store or at a First Hawaiian Bank branch ($2.50 fee).

autopay.note: AutoPay collects your bill 10 calendar days before the due date. Paying by credit card adds 2.5% of the bill each month; checking accounts and debit cards have no fee. Changes take effect within 2 business days.

autopay_cancel.note: To stop the next collection, cancel by 9:00 PM HST the night before the collection date.

cancel_service.note: To cancel some or all services, call 808-643-3456, chat with us or visit a Hawaiian Telcom retail store. Charges are prorated to your disconnection date.

change_plan.note: Service changes are made by calling 808-643-3456, chatting with us or visiting a retail store.

payment_arrangement.note: If you can't pay by the due date, call Customer Service at 808-643-2356 to ask about payment arrangements.

notes: In-person payments at First Hawaiian Bank branches cost $2.50.

help.title: Paying your Hawaiian Telcom bill
paragraphs: In My Account, select Pay Now in the Current Balance section of the Overview or Billing page. Linked accounts can be paid from the Account page. You get a confirmation email.
Fees: a one-time online payment costs $1.95 and a phone payment costs $1.95. Paying at a First Hawaiian Bank branch costs $2.50. Mail and AutoPay are free; bank bill pay fees are set by your bank.

Online, phone and retail store payments usually post within 2 business days; checks dropped at a store and bank bill pay can take up to 7 business days. Payment History in Billing shows the last 24 months.

help.title: Late payments and arrangements
paragraphs: If more than $10.00 is still unpaid 30 days after the due date, a late fee of 1.5% of the past-due balance or $15.95, whichever is greater, is charged.

If you can't pay on time because of illness or other circumstances beyond your control, call 808-643-2356 about payment arrangements. Service is not disconnected sooner than 14 days after the due date, and you receive written notice at least 7 days before.

help.title: AutoPay
paragraphs: Go to Billing, then AutoPay, then Enroll Today. Use a checking account, debit card or credit card; credit card AutoPay adds 2.5% of the total bill each month. You can pay the full bill or set a maximum amount.
AutoPay collects 10 calendar days before the due date. Changes take effect within 2 business days.

To stop AutoPay, open Billing, choose the AutoPay tab, select Edit next to your payment method, choose the option that you do not want AutoPay, and Save. Do it by 9:00 PM HST the night before the collection date.

help.title: eBill
paragraphs: eBill is free. Log in to My Account and select Get eBill on the Overview page. Your bill is ready to view 1 to 2 days after the billing date and you get a courtesy email.
New-customer promotions include an eBill discount that is removed if eBill is not activated within 30 days of signing up.

help.title: Change or cancel service
paragraphs: Service changes and cancellations are handled by our support team: call 808-643-3456, chat with us, or visit a Hawaiian Telcom retail store. An agent covers final payments, equipment return and any offers.
Your bill is prorated, so you pay only through the disconnection date. Phone-only customers can choose Vacation Service instead: 50% off line charges for a one-time $14.00 fee.

extra.intent: Using Hawaiian Telcom's help center, find the fee for a one-time online payment and the fee for paying at a First Hawaiian Bank branch. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
